purpose: Separate SOUNDNESS from BENEFIT across Papers I-V. Soundness says nothing bad happens; benefit says something good happens. A system that refuses everything satisfies every non-interference theorem in this programme and is useless. The capstone claim -- that ORION is a working mechanism -- rests on the benefit column, not the soundness column.
the_structural_trap: Any benefit claim of the form 'our gate catches the defects' is circular when the defects are defined by the gate. This is not a hypothetical: the Paper VI scoped-utility headline ('executing the gate contract cuts false promotion 3.31x at matched throughput') was self-retracted for exactly this reason -- the contrast arm read the same gate observations in which the defect was planted, and a closed-form prediction matched the 'measurement' to three decimals. Escaping the trap requires an outcome measure the mechanism does not define.

mechanics.detail: Machine-checked and axiom-free: no finite composition of uncertified operators moves the canonical projection. The non-vacuity witness proves a certified operator genuinely CAN move canonical state, ruling out the degenerate reading. But no experiment shows that enforcing non-escalation makes ORION better at research than an ungoverned arm. Soundness is established; benefit has not been attempted.

mechanics.non_vacuity_witness: RaklFormal.stabilized_is_fixed (a flat sequence does reach a fixed point, so the rule is not permanently open)
mechanics.detail: Least-fixed-point and stabilization halves machine-checked; the cardinality bound is not. Behaviourally bound to shipped code via PFC-SATURATION-REOPENS-ON-GROWTH. The benefit question -- does stopping on this rule beat stopping arbitrarily, in cost or in missed-source rate? -- is unasked. Note the external anchor available here: AutoResearchBench Wide Research scores set-completeness by IoU, which is the natural non-self-authored outcome for a saturation claim.

mechanics.non_vacuity_witness: The theorem is a negative result about representability; its content is the impossibility itself, and the incomparable pair in the paper's worked example witnesses that the order is genuinely partial.
mechanics.detail: Machine-checked. Enforced in shipped code (permits_scalar_ranking pinned false). Whether refusing to scalarize produces better decisions than scalarizing is a separate, unasked empirical question.

The six-family confirmatory passed every registered gate (6/6, p=0.03125, gain 0.360 vs MDE 0.05) and the gate was then shown structurally incapable of failing: scrambling every source_text/target_text left all six coordinates unchanged 810/810, one arm had variance 1.2e-37, and 12/12 seeds passed. The coordinates are string equalities on pre-parsed fields, so the outcome is determined by the same construction as the mechanism. The strongest surviving claim is a SPECIFICATION claim, not a transfer claim. Closure requires an instrument where scrambling the text destroys performance -- see the gate-falsifiability battery.

Mechanics reported closed. The load-bearing claim -- a fresh-task performance lift -- has never been demonstrated, and the four-arm causal attribution experiment is incomplete. This is the single largest benefit gap in the programme, because method evolution is what distinguishes ORION from a static pipeline.

The honest negative, and the most informative row in this ledger because its outcome measure was NOT self-authored. adaptive-v1 lost to the static structural parent. Failure attributed to the allocation policy (guard-rail budget capture: 13 vs 8 PRINCIPLE examples in every world). Decisively, the instrument cannot reach its own gate: a rigorous upper bound on ANY equal-budget policy's advantage over static is +0.0246 against a frozen 0.05 gate. Conventional power analysis misses this because the bootstrap CIs are ~0.0016 wide.

Architecture and theory reported ready; the strongest discovery-performance experiment is prospective. Separately, premise (iii) of the transformation-geometry proposition is not machine-enforced on a live path -- the gate's wiring layer exists but its call chain terminates in tests. A verified-discovery mechanic whose verifier is not on the live path cannot yet carry a benefit claim.

mechanics.ablation_arm: arm A conformance vs external availability anchor
mechanics.detail: The surviving result after the 3.31x retraction is a DERIVED OPERATING-REGIME CONSTRAINT, and it is a cost rather than a benefit: fail-closed governed acceptance carries a throughput tax of 0.897 to 1.000, and with a 12-gate contract per-gate evidence availability must reach 0.9816 for a 20% tax and 0.9913 for a 10% tax. It escapes circularity only because it composes ORION's rule with an EXTERNAL input (the verification-gap survey rates, arXiv:2608.05179) that was not chosen to produce the result, and the contract size was swept 0..12 rather than fixed at a favourable point. Retained here because an honest cost is load-bearing for the capstone: it sets the bar any benefit must clear.

programme_finding.statement: Across Papers I-VI, ZERO mechanics currently carry a demonstrated benefit. Soundness is strong and increasingly machine-checked; cost is measured and high; benefit is absent. The one benefit claim that existed was self-retracted as tautological.
programme_finding.why_this_matters: The capstone claim is that ORION is a WORKING mechanism. That claim rests entirely on the benefit column. Non-interference theorems cannot supply it -- they are satisfied by a system that never acts, which is why every MECHANIZED row above is required to name a non-vacuity witness.
programme_finding.what_would_close_it: One mechanic beating a matched ablation on an outcome measure the mechanism does not define, on fresh tasks, through a gate shown capable of failing. The most tractable candidates are MECH-BOUNDED-SATURATION against an external set-completeness benchmark, and MECH-METHOD-EVOLUTION on fresh-task lift.
programme_finding.honest_caveat: This ledger is a structural audit, not evidence. A BENEFIT_DEMONSTRATED verdict would record only that a claim is structurally ELIGIBLE to be a benefit claim -- never that the effect is real or that it replicates.

open_residuals.statement: Five of eight mechanics have benefit NOT_ATTEMPTED. Not attempted is not 'no benefit' -- it is unmeasured, and must not be reported either way.
open_residuals.closure_action: Design one matched-ablation experiment per mechanic with an outcome measure external to it.

open_residuals.statement: Four mechanics carry no non-vacuity witness, so a soundness result for them could in principle hold vacuously.
open_residuals.closure_action: For each, exhibit a case where the mechanic demonstrably changes an outcome.

open_residuals.statement: The ledger is hand-authored, so a mechanic absent from it is invisible rather than reported as unaudited.
open_residuals.closure_action: Cross-reference against the Paper I theorem inventory and the external-agent mechanic records.
